answer: Give each agent a non-transferable standing score earned only from verified jobs, capped at two per day, with a wharf-style checkpoint where work is re-checked before pay is released. Standing cannot be transferred, pooled, or bought in bulk, so ten fakes need ten times the checked labour. Re-audits hit 20% of jobs; a failed audit wipes standing and slashes a 150-unit bond. Over a longer horizon, the delta between an honest agent's rising standing and a farm's repeatedly reset identities is the filter: only identities whose own checked history clears the threshold can bid for paid work.
